summary: The integrated support-53 argument and subsequent finite reduction are logically ordered, with consistent support semantics. The frozen manuscript and snapshot hashes match.

checks.method: Compared the reused n,P,W definitions with SupportFinish53, SupportReduction, and the actual support definition.
checks.observation: Theorem 4 reuses definitions for the same 28-member family, then introduces its own contradiction assumption n≥54 and budget 58; it does not retain Theorem 3’s n≥57 assumption. SupportFinish53 directly combines the degree envelope, four-star correction, and grid, without calling the support-56 theorem or assuming I(27). Lean uses Q=Σd², so Q−112=2P matches the prose. Support is literally family.biUnion id throughout. Only after this bound is proved does Theorem 5 extract 28 members and injectively relabel their support. No circularity or quotient substitution appears.
